summary.text: On February 11, 2025, Vance described AI as offering revolutionary benefits across multiple fields and urged an opportunity-focused approach while acknowledging safety concerns. He advocated worker-centered AI policies intended to increase productivity, wages, benefits, and community prosperity. In September and October 2026, he emphasized AI companies' responsibility to build safe tools and be held responsible for harms they warn their technology could cause.
